name: @chtaylo3/backstage-validation-engine
description: Shared, source-preserving Backstage catalog validation contracts and engine foundations

scripts.test: node scripts/clean.mjs tests && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=30000 .test-dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:harness: node scripts/clean.mjs tests && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=30000 .test-dist/test/fixture-matrix.test.js .test-dist/test/catalog-api.test.js .test-dist/test/catalog-provider.test.js .test-dist/test/backstage-references.test.js .test-dist/test/release-refresh.test.js .test-dist/test/catalog-rules.test.js .test-dist/test/lsp.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/clean.mjs tests && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=30000 --experimental-test-coverage .test-dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run schemas:check && npm test
scripts.test:lsp: node scripts/clean.mjs tests && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=30000 .test-dist/test/catalog-rules.test.js .test-dist/test/lsp.test.js
